effort_note: Higher Effort lets the analysis spend more of its output allowance on reasoning. It does not promise a better result or a fixed running time, and it can need more credits.
size_note: Longer sources need more points: about one more point for each 2,000 characters of plain English text. Characters of other scripts count more (Hebrew letters about twice as much, emoji about four times), and your own quote gives the exact number.
rules: A credit is one point of application usage on this server. It has no fixed money value and cannot be bought, sold or exchanged here.

Before an analysis runs you get a quote: the exact number of points for that prepared analysis, its Effort and its source, under one credit-policy version, valid until the time it states. Nothing runs until you approve it.

Approving reserves the quoted points and one run of today's daily allowance. When a result is recorded the quoted points are charged; if nothing was sent they are returned. If the server cannot tell whether a run was sent, the points stay held until an administrator settles them. You are never charged more than the quote you approved.
The daily allowance counts new analysis runs per calendar day and is separate from points: a run uses one slot whatever its points, and a run that is returned gives its slot back.
Points do not buy a running time or a better result. Higher Effort lets the analysis spend more of its output allowance on reasoning and can need more points.
Reading, reviewing and exporting saved results, adding a source, preparing an analysis and asking for a quote use no points and no allowance.
